prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one extremely polished native Android phone APP SCREEN, edge to edge portrait 1080x2340, no device bezel, no perspective, no desk, no poster treatment, no design-board labels outside the screen. This is the Chinese personal lottery DATA ORGANIZATION app "叁序", not a gambling sales app. A real usable screen with restrained modern Chinese mobile-app design, comparable to a beautifully art-directed mainstream native financial/utility app. Sharp high-quality Simplified Chinese sans typography. Use white #FFFFFF, clean near-white #F7F7F5, charcoal #242424, secondary gray #716F6D, and a committed cinnabar/crimson #D9363E accent (selected controls, current step, one primary action). NO blue or cyan anywhere. No beige parchment, no serif, no gradients, no glows, no excessive enclosing cards, no tiny text, no fake charts, no advertising. Clear type scale, carefully aligned 20dp gutters, ample rhythm. Material-native controls, every touch target at least48dp relative to393dp screen width. A slim Android status bar 9:41 and system gesture inset. Persistent5-item bottom navigation with coherent outline icons and Chinese labels 首页 走势 选号 方案 彩报; 选号 active red. Four plain top method tabs 单选 组选 单选单 位选, 位选 selected with red underline. Header title "选号", secondary Tools icon with label "工具". A compact issue selector "第2026300期" and small "位选" method hint. The demonstrated editable state is hundreds {0,1}, tens {0}, units {2,7}. All three positional selections must remain readable, but ONLY TEN numeric buttons 0–9 are visible in ONE current-position chooser. The numbers are 48dp circular or very softly rounded outline chips in two rows of5, not a wall of large rectangular tiles. Only0 selected in red because currently editing tens. Repeated digits in a tiny combination PREVIEW are plain text, never more selectable grids. Valid live result: four combinations 002,007,102,107, 4注 at1倍 cost8元. Chinese instruction unambiguous: "选择十位" and "可多选，点选后查看组合". Real labels, precise sample numbers, leading zeroes preserved. Primary save is "加入方案". No purchase, prediction, recommended numbers, winning rate or promises. Avoid long prose.
COMPOSITION A: Guide strip and calm open workspace. After the method tabs, a horizontal three-part selection strip, each equal-width segment labeled 百位 / 十位 / 个位. Show selected values "0  1" / "0" / "2  7" in medium-large black text. Tens segment has a very subtle pale-red background and an underline; small checks show the other positions have selections. A fine red progress line connects the three labels without looking like a decorative infographic. Below, a generous open white region with title "选择十位", one helper line, then TWO rows of5 lightweight number circles0..9. About40% screen height for this main region. Bottom of region a compact rightward text control "下一步：个位 →", and small clear control attached to the section title. Next a distinctly separated yet borderless review region on a faint warm-gray ground: heading "组合预览" with "4注" on same baseline; plain codes 002 007 102 107, evenly aligned, no pills. At the bottom above navigation, a clean fixed white task bar: left "合计 ¥8" with "1倍" inline stepper, right a red "加入方案" button. The screen should feel organized and human, not technical and not empty. No duplicated titles or repeated instructions.
